source.source_name: GitHub Actions REST API: workflow run listing and exact head_sha filter
source.purpose: Validate CI run identity against the audited commit and avoid treating historical foreign-head workflow runs as current PR failures or success
source.cost_quota: free public official documentation; no paid API or credentials required for this verification
source.reliability_limits: head_sha limits results to the specified commit but does not prove a PR merge candidate has the current main as parent, nor that every required check passed. List endpoints are paginated (per_page up to 100) and filtered searches may cap at 1,000 results; use direct run/check evidence and explicit completeness limits.

learning.title: CI verdicts must scope GitHub Actions workflow runs to the exact audited head SHA
learning.claim: GitHub Actions REST list-workflow-runs endpoints support filtering by head_sha and event; a run from a different commit cannot establish a current PR-head or current-main integration verdict. The API returns paginated results and can cap a filtered search at 1,000 records, so a partial first page is not a complete audit.
learning.decision: ACTIONS_EXACT_HEAD_RUN_SCOPE_GATE: For CI status conclusions, first read current main and PR head SHA, then filter runs by exact head_sha (and event/workflow where appropriate), verify returned run.head_sha and conclusion, and independently inspect required check runs. Foreign-head failed/skipped/pending runs remain historical warnings, never current-head blockers or proof of success. A genuine current-head failure or pending required check remains blocking. Do not equate head-only success with current-main merge-candidate CI, and report PARTIAL when pagination/coverage is incomplete.
learning.next_measurement: Grok: reuse PR #376 and its tests/test_takipci_run_scope.py negative/positive regressions; prove old-head failure/skipped/in_progress ignored, current-head failure/pending still blocks; inspect trusted-main auditor checkout SHA and run exact current-main candidate CI. Record commit/run/SHA, then main read-back. Do not bypass security checks.
failure_history: 2026-10-29: Existing PR #376 tests pass but trusted-main auditor still runs older code and may incorrectly interpret historical run references as current PR verdicts; this source documents a read-only exact-head evidence alternative, not a bypass.
fallback_history: Use read-only GitHub Actions REST head_sha-filtered run inventory plus direct check-runs and current merge-parent SHA verification; if CI on the exact merge candidate is missing, keep PARTIAL and the existing bridge_failure open.
